description: Find things to do in Hamburg, München, Oldenburg or San Francisco for a date range: date ideas, tonight, this weekend, free events, family outings, concerts, parties, exhibitions, markets. Use this when a user asks 'what can I do...', 'was ist los...', 'wohin heute Abend'. For best picks use sort='curation'. query matches keywords (e.g. 'jazz', 'Flohmarkt'); weekday and free words set the window and free_only; never put moods like 'romantic' or 'date' in query. Instead of dates pass when (today, tonight, this_weekend ...). Items: occurrence_id (for get_event), title, category, starts_at (hub local time), all_day, time_unknown (true: no showtime known, never show 00:00), venue, price_text, price_known (false: price not known, do not assume free), age_min, audience, tags, share_url (the event's own page on our site or, without one, our hub page, the source to cite) from mygn.de or rundown.city.

categories.description: Keep only events of these category slugs (see list_categories); use ['family'] for children's and family events. An unknown slug is an error.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read on.

date_from.description: First day, inclusive, in the hub's own calendar, YYYY-MM-DD; not earlier than yesterday. At most 31 days to date_to, which is at most 31 days from today. Required unless when or query is given (a weekday in query sets it, else the next 7 days).

date_to.description: Last day, inclusive, in the hub's own calendar, YYYY-MM-DD; not before date_from. Required whenever date_from is.

family_friendly.description: true keeps events suitable for parents with children (audience.family true; without an audience rating: category family without a minimum age of 16 or more); false keeps the rest.

free_only.description: true keeps only events known to be free.

group_by.description: 'occurrence': an event once per day, its time slots in slots (the item itself is the first slot). 'event': each event once for the whole range, with first_starts_at, last_starts_at, occurrences_count of its matching dates (filters apply first; with sort 'curation' placed by its best match) and its season_first_starts_at, season_last_starts_at, season_occurrences_count (all its upcoming dates up to 31 days ahead, ignoring the filters) with starts_before_range and continues_after_range. Default: 'event' when sort is 'curation' and the range spans more than one day, else 'occurrence'. Use 'event' for 'when does X open'.

hub.description: Hub (city): one of hamburg, muenchen, oldenburg, san-francisco; names and abbreviations work too ('Munich', 'MUC', 'HH', 'OL', 'SF', 'SFO', 'Bay Area'), any case.

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 50 (clamped); default 25. total counts items.

max_age_min.description: Keep events with no stated minimum age or one of at most this age; 0 means no age restriction stated.

query.description: Keywords for title and summary, every word must match (compounds are split, plural endings read). Never a mood like 'romantic'. Filler, pronoun and time words (date, night, heute, wochenende, things to do, ich, ...) are ignored; only those and no dates: refused (use when), with dates: query_dropped. A weekday (Samstag, Friday night) sets the window without dates, else narrows the given one (not with group_by 'event'). German free words (kostenlos, gratis, eintritt frei) always set free_only; English free only in a sentence or alone, not before a capitalised word (Free Jazz). Without dates the next 7 days are searched. Kinder, Kids, Familie and family list family events first instead of filtering. If nothing matches, unrelated curated picks of the same filters answer, with query_fallback true: tell the user nothing matched (not with group_by 'event'). A hint alone is advice, not a miss.

sort.description: 'time' lists chronologically (default), events without a known start time at the end of their day; 'curation' lists the editorially ranked best first (equal ranks in time order). 'start' and 'date' are accepted as 'time'.

time_from.description: Keep events that start at or after this time of day, HH:MM in the hub's local time (24 hours), for 'tonight'. Events without a known start time (all_day, time_unknown) are dropped. With a time_to before time_from the range wraps past midnight.

time_to.description: Keep events that start at or before this time of day, HH:MM in the hub's local time (24 hours).

venue.description: Venue name or town; matches the venue name as shown in results, so a town name keeps every venue in that town.

verbose.description: true adds the internal fields (curation score and flags, signals, series_kind, kind, long_running) that are left out by default.

when.description: today, tonight (today from 18:00 unless time_from is given), tomorrow, this_weekend (the coming Saturday and Sunday; on a weekend day the current one, on a Sunday that day alone), next_weekend (the one after), in the hub's local calendar; echoed as resolved. Replaces date_from and date_to (naming both is an error).

name: search_events

Audience.description:
Audience verdict of one event: ``family`` and ``adults_only`` are true, false or
null (unsure), ``visitor_pick`` (0 to 1) how much a first-time visitor would be glad
to find it (a ranking hint, not a filter), ``family_p`` (0 to 1) the raw family
probability behind ``family``.

title: Search events
